# Welcome to 🦀 CrabCraft
_A whitelisted vanilla-style server focused on a friendly atmosphere, community builds, and survival fun._

## Overview

CrabCraft is a long running vanilla SMP focused on keeping Minecraft simple fair and fun. No gimmicks and no pay to win. Just quality of life features that enhance the game without changing how it is meant to be played. Inspired by HermitCraft.

## What we offer
1. Pure vanilla gameplay with light quality of life improvements
2. Proxmity voice chat utilising [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat/)
3. No ranks or paid perks, **ever**
4. Frequent backups with per chunk rollback protection
5. An active and respectful community

## Season Stats
Last season **over 400 players** joined CrabCraft, logging a combined 17,000+ hours of playtime. We are proud of the community that has grown here and excited to make future seasons even better. <3

## How to join
Join [our Discord](https://discord.crabcraft.net/) to fill out a quick application, and we'll get back to you shortly.
